about: T-1143: rule-context JSON text both tiers refuse, or admit, at the input envelope. The expected outcome of each case is read from RFC 7493 (I-JSON), not from either tier: section 2.1 forbids a surrogate code point, escaped or not (its own example is an escaped unpaired surrogate), and section 2.3 forbids a repeated member name. Each text is the JSON text handed to RuleInstance.FromJsonText / fromJsonText. A marker such as <U+D800> stands for that one raw UTF-16 code unit, which this file cannot hold itself.

cases.name: repeated member name after unescaping, one level down
raw lone high surrogate in a string
escaped lone high surrogate in a string
escaped lone low surrogate in a string
raw lone high surrogate in a member name
escaped lone high surrogate in a member name
escaped lone low surrogate in a member name
the same name in two different objects
